title: KS-485 (security review hub): demote from High to Medium?
bluf: The ticket describes itself as 'the coordination hub and living plan' (ticket description) and cannot be closed by work: it has accumulated 100 or more comments, mostly deploy notes (newest 0a07c0bc, 2026-11-08, is a Kintsugi deploy record). No comment says to demote or park it (searched the ticket's 100 comments for 'demote' and 'priority'; none about its own priority). The work items it indexes carry their own priorities (e.g. the register rows are filed High or Medium; comment text). Priority is your field. If you demote it, the board seat changes the field to Medium; nothing else changes and it stays the place deploy notes are posted. Source of the 'demote' suggestion: the 2026-11-09 triage (its own proposal, not a comment on the ticket).

options.label: Demote to Medium
options.detail: The board seat sets the priority; the hub keeps receiving deploy notes. The High lane then lists real work only.

options.label: Keep High
options.detail: No change; a never-closing hub stays in the High count.

options.label: Close the hub and start a new one
options.detail: Needs a handover rewrite; not recommended (cost UNMEASURED).

default_action: After 48 h: b. Nothing changes; Wednesday re-asks you.
